# uuid58

> uuid58 shortens UUIDs to fixed 22-character Base58 strings (Bitcoin alphabet), and back. Strings are URL-safe, have no look-alike characters (0, O, I, l), and sort in the same order as the UUIDs they encode, so UUIDv7 stays time-ordered. One stable spec (1.1.0) and 200+ shared test vectors make every implementation produce the same string.

Example: `f4b247fd-1f87-45d4-aa06-1c6fc0a8dfaf` ⇄ `XDY9dmBbcMBXqcRvYw8xJ2`

Key facts:

- Conversion is lossless both ways: keep UUIDs in your database and show uuid58 in URLs, APIs, and logs.
- The format is fixed by spec 1.1.0 and does not change within spec 1.x.
- Lean proofs cover the spec's core guarantees (lossless round trips, fixed 22-character length, order preservation) and verify the JavaScript library and the Rust codec against the spec for every input. Other implementations are checked with the shared test vectors.
- Not interchangeable with short-uuid (npm, Flickr Base58 by default), shortuuid (Python, 57-character alphabet), or slugid (URL-safe Base64), even though those are also 22 characters.
- The JavaScript package encodes in about 0.5 µs and decodes in about 0.3 µs on Node.js, several times faster than short-uuid and bs58.

## Docs

- [Website and online converter](https://nakanoasaservice.github.io/uuid58/): convert and generate in the browser, with code samples for every language
- [Specification](https://nakanoasaservice.github.io/uuid58/spec/): alphabet, encoding, decoding, accepted inputs, validation, errors, and test vector format
- [Test vectors](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/blob/main/spec/vectors.json): shared conformance cases
- [Sitemap](https://nakanoasaservice.github.io/uuid58/sitemap.xml): every page on the site
- [Repository README](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58#readme): install commands, comparison with other ID formats, and FAQ

## Libraries

- [JavaScript / TypeScript](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/js#readme): `npm i @nakanoaas/uuid58` (npm and JSR)
- [Go](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/go#readme): `go get github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/go`, plus a command-line tool
- [Python](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/python#readme): `pip install uuid58`
- [Rust](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/rust#readme): `cargo add uuid58` (no_std)
- [Java / Kotlin](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/java#readme): `io.github.nakanoasaservice:uuid58:0.1.1` on Maven Central
- [Swift](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58-swift): Swift Package Manager
- [PostgreSQL](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/postgres#readme): one SQL file, no extension
- [MySQL / MariaDB](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/mysql#readme): one SQL file, no extension
- [C# / .NET](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/dotnet#readme): `dotnet add package Uuid58` ([NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Uuid58))
- [PHP](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58-php#readme): `composer require nakanoaas/uuid58` ([Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/nakanoaas/uuid58))
- [Ruby](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/ruby#readme): `bundle add uuid58` ([RubyGems](https://rubygems.org/gems/uuid58))
- [Dart / Flutter](https://github.com/nakanoasaservice/uuid58/tree/main/dart#readme): `dart pub add uuid58` ([pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/uuid58))
- [Elixir](https://uuid58.hexdocs.pm/): add `{:uuid58, "~> 0.1.1"}` to `deps` in `mix.exs` ([Hex](https://hex.pm/packages/uuid58)); includes Phoenix and Ecto usage examples
